column1: # Reviewed reach verdicts for the baseline image (nginx 1.25.5, Debian 12, amd64).
# Read by scripts/compare-scans.py (make triage). Written by hand, following
# verdict: always | common | config | manual | unused | n/a | unknown (see the skill for the meaning and weights)
# evidence: where the claim can be checked. "src/..." paths are in the nginx-1.25.5 source tarball from nginx.org.
# package, severity: only for CVEs the scanners do not report (nginx.org advisories); left empty otherwise.
# Reviewed on 2026-10-05: every CVE in a package nginx loads, every known-exploited CVE,
# every CVE with EPSS >= 5%, and every nginx.org advisory whose range includes 1.25.5.

column3: reason

HTTP/2 Rapid Reset reaches nginx only when HTTP/2 is switched on (the image's default config serves HTTP/1.1 on port 80), but most TLS sites switch it on. nginx 1.25.5 contains upstream's mitigation: commit 6ceef19 "HTTP/2: per-iteration stream handling limit", dated 2023-10-10 (the disclosure day), caps new streams per event-loop pass at twice the concurrent-stream limit, so reset floods are cut off. The commit does not name the CVE, and the score has no "mitigated" factor; the verdict says only that the code runs.
nginx calls X509_check_host() only after verifying an upstream server's certificate, which happens only with proxy_ssl_verify on (or the grpc/uwsgi/stream equivalents); off by default.
CMS message parsing. nginx never calls OpenSSL's CMS functions.
Needs the non-default SSL_OP_NO_TICKET option with TLSv1.3. nginx sets it only when ssl_session_tickets is off; the default is on.
Heap overflow only on 32-bit platforms. The image is linux/amd64.
PKCS#7 / S-MIME signature verification. nginx never calls PKCS7 functions.
Needs delta CRL processing (X509_V_FLAG_USE_DELTAS). With ssl_crl nginx sets only CRL_CHECK and CRL_CHECK_ALL.
CMS EnvelopedData parsing. nginx never calls CMS functions.
CMS AuthEnvelopedData. nginx never calls CMS functions.
PKCS#12 file parsing. nginx loads certificates and keys from PEM and never calls PKCS12 functions.
DANE TLSA client authentication. nginx never enables DANE.
CMS EnvelopedData parsing. nginx never calls CMS functions.
scanf with %mc. nginx never calls scanf; other programs in the image could, only when someone runs them by hand.
pcre2_dfa_match(). nginx uses pcre2_match() only.
DTLS retransmission. nginx has no DTLS; its QUIC code is separate.
32-bit platforms only, and in pcre2_pattern_convert(), which nginx never calls.
column4: advisory text; no pcre2_pattern_convert in src

column3: Needs an attacker-controlled regular expression. nginx compiles only the regexes in its own config; requests supply the subject, not the pattern.
pcre2_jit_match() with a copied subject. nginx calls pcre2_match(), never pcre2_jit_match().
Needs SSL_select_next_proto() with an empty list. nginx calls it with its own non-empty ALPN list.
CMP protocol. nginx never uses CMP.
CMS password-based decryption. nginx never calls CMS functions.
RSASVE key encapsulation. Not used by TLS or by nginx.
CMS decryption (CMS_decrypt). nginx never calls CMS functions.
AES-OCB through EVP_Cipher(). TLS has no OCB cipher suites, and nginx's QUIC code uses EVP_CipherUpdate/Final.
iconv() with IBM1390/IBM1399. nginx never calls iconv.
getnetbyaddr(). nginx never calls it.
PKCS12_get_friendlyname(). nginx never calls PKCS12 functions.
Affects statically linked setuid programs. nginx is dynamically linked and not setuid; that the image has no static setuid programs is assumed, not checked.
ungetwc() on wide streams. nginx never calls it.
Deprecated debug functions ns_printrr/fp_nquery. nginx never calls them.
gethostbyaddr(). nginx never calls it; it uses its own resolver and getaddrinfo() at startup.
strfmon(). nginx never calls it.

EVP_Cipher() on an empty AEAD ciphertext. nginx's QUIC code uses EVP_CipherUpdate/Final, and OpenSSL 3.0.11's TLS record layer calls EVP_Cipher() only for legacy (engine) ciphers; built-in ciphers take the EVP_CipherUpdate path and TLS 1.3 uses Update/Final. An engine cipher would need the ssl_engine directive (not checked further).
X9.42 DH key checks via DH_generate_key/DH_check_pub_key. nginx never calls them, and the OpenSSL advisory says the TLS implementation is not affected.
column4: no DH_check calls in nginx-1.25.5/src; advisory text

column3: PKCS#12 parsing. nginx never calls PKCS12 functions.
Only applications calling SSL_free_buffers() are affected. nginx never calls it.
POLY1305 on PowerPC CPUs only. The image is amd64.
libcurl HTTP/2 push. Only the curl tool uses libcurl; nginx has its own HTTP code.
Needs an ASN.1 element over 2 GB. nginx decodes ASN.1 only from TLS peers, whose certificate chains OpenSSL caps far below that, and from local files.
CMS password-based decryption. nginx never calls CMS functions.
TimeStamp response verification. nginx never calls TS functions.
Integer overflow in ASN1_mbstring_ncopy() that needs a string of hundreds of millions of characters; TLS input to nginx is far smaller. Size bound taken from the advisory, not tested.
DTLS. nginx has no DTLS.
wordexp(). nginx never calls it.
Deprecated debug functions ns_printrr/fp_nquery. nginx never calls them.
iconv() with EUC_JISX0213. nginx never calls iconv.
iconv() with SHIFT_JISX0213. nginx never calls iconv.
Needs an attacker-controlled alignment near 2^62 for memalign. nginx passes fixed alignments (16 bytes, the page size, or directio_alignment from its config).
DTLS 1.2. nginx has no DTLS.
Overflow while printing a failed assert(). nginx never calls assert().

resolv.conf with a search domain of about 200 characters makes getaddrinfo() abort. nginx calls getaddrinfo() at startup when the config names a host; resolv.conf is set by whoever runs the container, not by a remote attacker.
wordexp() with a long ~username. nginx never calls wordexp.
pcre2_match() reading invalid UTF after a JIT fallback. Needs pcre_jit on and a pattern in UTF mode ((*UTF) in the config); the URI it matches is attacker-controlled.
column4: src/core/ngx_regex.c:672; no PCRE2_UTF set by nginx

column3: Needs the PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF option. nginx never sets it.
Crash in the nscd service. nscd is not installed in the image.
32-bit platforms only (pcre2_compile_32). The image is amd64 and nginx uses the 8-bit library.
tdelete() on a very deep tree. nginx never calls tdelete.
CMP client. nginx never uses CMP.
POSIX regcomp(). nginx uses PCRE2, not regcomp.
crc32_combine64(). nginx calls deflate/inflate, never crc32_combine.
fopen() with an attacker-controlled ",ccs=" mode. nginx never calls fopen.
Local privilege escalation through setuid programs with $ORIGIN in RPATH. Needs a local attacker; nginx is not setuid.
MiniZip is a separate library (Debian's libminizip), not part of zlib1g. Trivy alone reports it.
BEAST against TLS 1.0 CBC in GnuTLS. Only tools that use GnuTLS (apt's HTTPS transport) could reach it; nginx uses OpenSSL.
Low-level GF(2^m) curve APIs with explicit parameters. TLS uses named curves; the OpenSSL advisory says the protocols are not affected.
Terminal escape sequences in logs, reported against nginx 0.7.64. nginx 1.25.5 escapes non-printable characters in its access log, and the image sends logs to stdout.
EVP_PKEY_public_check() on RSA keys. nginx never calls it; the OpenSSL advisory says TLS is not affected.
OpenSSL's HTTP client with no_proxy and an IPv6 host. nginx has its own OCSP HTTP client and never calls OpenSSL's.
column4: no OSSL_HTTP or OCSP_sendreq calls in nginx-1.25.5/src

column3: DSA key checks via EVP_PKEY_param_check/public_check. nginx never calls them.
CMS password-based decryption. nginx never calls CMS functions.
ECDSA signing timing leak. Needs an ECDSA certificate (the advisory names P-521 as the realistic case) and local or very low-latency timing access.
CMP server extraCerts cache. nginx never uses CMP.

CMP client. nginx never uses CMP.
gethostbyaddr(). nginx never calls it.
Memory growth from a certificate with many CRL distribution points. nginx parses peer certificates only when it asks clients for one (ssl_verify_client) or talks to https upstreams.
ECDSA timing leak on curves without a dedicated implementation. Needs an ECDSA certificate on such a curve plus precise timing access.
SM2 signatures. nginx's TLS does not negotiate SM2 (assumed from OpenSSL 3.0 defaults, not tested).
AES-SIV and AES-GCM-SIV. Not used by TLS or nginx.
BIO_f_linebuffer filter. nginx never uses it.
PKCS#12 parsing. nginx never calls PKCS12 functions.
wordexp(). nginx never calls it.
Low-level OCB API. Not used by TLS or nginx.
Loader overflow in setuid programs with $ORIGIN in RPATH. Needs a local attacker; nginx is not setuid.
strncasecmp optimized for Power8. The image is amd64.
DHX (X9.42) peer keys. TLS key exchange uses plain DH or ECDH, not DHX.
Affects zlib 1.3.1.2 to 1.3.2. The image has zlib 1.2.13.
glibc POSIX regex recursion. nginx uses PCRE2, not glibc regex.
Stack-guard bypass that only helps exploit another overflow. Upstream treats it as a non-security bug.
ASLR weakening that only helps exploit another bug. Upstream treats it as a non-security bug.
Needs a victim to run ldd on attacker files. Nothing in the container does that.
glob() CPU use on crafted patterns. nginx calls glob() only for wildcard include lines in its own config.
glibc POSIX regex recursion, disputed by upstream. nginx uses PCRE2.
Guessing thread heap addresses. Upstream says ASLR bypass alone is not a vulnerability.
World-readable log files. In this image the log files are links to stdout and stderr.
Timing attack on PowerPC only. The image is amd64.
KeyTrap is a DNSSEC validator bug. It is filed against the systemd source package because of systemd-resolved, which is not in libsystemd0 and does not run in the container.
DNSSEC NSEC3 validator bug, filed against systemd for systemd-resolved, which is not in libsystemd0 and does not run in the container.
FreeType font parsing. Only image-filter pulls in FreeType (through libgd), and that module never draws text: it only reads, resizes, rotates, crops and writes JPEG/GIF/PNG/WebP.
nghttp2 CONTINUATION flood. libnghttp2 is used only by curl; nginx has its own HTTP/2 code.
libcurl ASN.1 date parser. Only the curl tool uses libcurl.
Bug in the slapd LDAP server. Only the libldap client library is installed.
libtiff memory leaks. image-filter reads only JPEG, GIF, PNG and WebP, never TIFF.
In OpenLDAP's Mozilla NSS TLS code (tls_m.c). Debian builds libldap with GnuTLS instead (assumed from Debian's build, not checked).
Buffer overflow when using map with a regular expression. Needs a map block that uses a regex.
Memory disclosure in the slice module. Needs the slice directive.
Use-after-free in the SSI module. Needs ssi on.
Buffer overflow in the gRPC proxy module. Needs grpc_pass.
Buffer over-read in the charset module. Needs charset conversion configured.

HTTP/3 address spoofing. Needs listen ... quic.
Resolver use-after-free in OCSP. Needs OCSP stapling or ssl_ocsp with a resolver.
